findings: Observed mean absolute logit error was 0.23048 for g4 and 0.45694 for g8.
The component-wise reconstruction produced only 0.08625 for g4 and 0.08218 for g8.
Reconstruction MAE was 0.24617 for g4 and 0.46063 for g8, so the proposed decomposition did not reproduce the full-layer discrepancy.
g8 had larger pre-cancellation absolute residual mass, 0.20588 versus 0.15649, but also substantially greater estimated cancellation, 0.6041 versus 0.4517.
g8 amplitude L1 per output was larger, 132.38 versus 90.30, while mean absolute amplitude per parameter was smaller, 0.02111 versus 0.02880.
interpretation: The preregistered amplitude-accumulation explanation is not supported by the attempted decomposition because the sum of separately evaluated component residuals does not reconstruct the observed full-layer reference-to-Q.ANT error. Before testing amplitude regularization, the additivity assumption and the exact semantics of calc_kan_layer_fprop must be validated in controlled synthetic tensor shapes.
next_research_direction: Run a synthetic additivity ladder that compares one full calc_kan_layer_fprop call with sums of calls split by Fourier component and input channel, beginning at 1x1x1 and increasing dimensions. Separate Q.ANT full-call additivity from exact-cosine reference mismatch.
limitations: CPU backend only; no photonic hardware performance claim.
The failed reconstruction may reflect the diagnostic method rather than non-additive backend behaviour.
Only 1000 FashionMNIST test examples were used.
